glyphClassification.digit: single code point in number ranges (General_Category N*)
glyphClassification.punctuation: single code point in punctuation ranges (General_Category P*)
glyphClassification.unknownFutureCodepoints: symbol until the pinned spec is explicitly refreshed

unicode.parityScope: Classification and display plans are pinned. General normalization and engine-backed segmentation have the implementation-specific limits below; exact cross-language output is guaranteed only within that intersection.

renderPlan.output: Ordered per-role display slots; slot cardinality determines head folding and cluster splitting

browser.segmentation: engine Intl.Segmenter when available; code point fallback otherwise

python.customFonts: per-call FontDefinition with trusted CSS and explicit metadata

go.normalization: Hangul NFC only; other canonical sequences are preserved
go.customFonts: per-call FontDefinition with trusted CSS and explicit metadata

rust.normalization: Hangul NFC only; other canonical sequences are preserved
rust.customFonts: per-call FontDefinition with trusted CSS and explicit metadata

ruby.segmentation: engine each_grapheme_cluster; pre-15.1 Unicode lacks Indic GB9c
ruby.customFonts: per-call FontDefinition with trusted CSS and explicit metadata

customFontDefinition.scope: one render call; no process-global registry mutation
customFontDefinition.material: system; browser-only vector registration and automatic URL loading are unavailable in static HTML
customFontDefinition.precedence: font_definition selects the font over font; per-call longhand depth overrides shorthand, then definition defaults
